description: Compute the stiffnesses to be added to gridpoints (default b = false ). The computed stiffness is multiplied by the stiffness factor (see the wall-zone stiffness-factor command). When enabled, the stiffnesses of the contacts are not added to the gridpoint stiffnesses. Instead, the current gridpoint stiffnesses are multiplied by the stiffness factor and added back to the gridpoint stiffnesses. This provides a stiffness that is closer to a continuity condition independent of scale provided that the contact stiffness are consistent with the gridpoint stiffnesses.

examples.description: Add contact stiffnesses to the gridpoints

notes: The 6.0 manual documents this command too, but the 6.00 binaries have no coupling commands at all (live top-level command enumeration on the PFC3D 6.00 GUI).
verification: Live-verified 2026-11-09 on PFC2D and PFC3D 7.00 and 9.8 consoles (plus the PFC3D 6.00 GUI for the 6.0 verdict) (syntax grade): takes a mandatory boolean on 2D and 3D, 7.00 and 9.8.
